summary_en: ¥6,000M upper limit, 415,000 shares (1.66% of S/O ex-treasury), acquisition window Aug 3–Dec 30, 2026, open-market method, price ceiling not disclosed. Program to be adjusted post-5-for-1 stock split effective Oct 1, 2026 (2,075,000 shares adjusted limit). Rationale: shareholder return enhancement per 5-year 60% payout-ratio target (FY2025–FY2029).
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
On July 31, 2026, Makino Milling Machine Co., Ltd. announced authorization to repurchase up to 415,000 shares of its own common stock for a maximum of ¥6.0 billion during the period August 3 to December 30, 2026, via open-market purchases. The authorized share count represents 1.66% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), calculated on a base of 24,893,841 shares outstanding as of June 30, 2026.

The company simultaneously announced a 5-for-1 stock split effective October 1, 2026. The repurchase authorization will be automatically adjusted post-split to 2,075,000 shares (same economic value).

The repurchase is undertaken in accordance with the company's published medium-term capital allocation policy ("Corporate Value Enhancement 2026 Update"), which targets a 5-year average payout ratio of 60% (FY2025–FY2029) through stable, continuous dividends and opportunistic share repurchases. The program aims to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
